item.author: Dr. Zachary Vance

item.title: The Search for Dark Matter
item.description: A particle physics investigation into the invisible universe: the strong CP problem, Primakoff conversion mechanics, cryogenic microwave haloscopes, and the hunt for QCD axions.
item.author: Julian Mercer

item.title: Hydrothermal Vents & The Spark of Life
item.description: An investigation into deep ocean ultramafic hydrothermal systems, proton gradients across iron-sulfur mineral membranes, and the thermodynamic origins of organic synthesis in the hadal zone.
item.author: Julian Mercer

item.author: Julian Mercer
